Class MoodDesk

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.mood.MoodDesk
All Implemented Interfaces:
MoodDoor
public final class MoodDesk extends Object implements MoodDoor
The MoodDesk type is the shared MoodDoor implementation. The canvas, group, and pipe pushes ask this type for the system lines. The SSH session asks this type to rewrite the stored transcript. The stored transcript is the Roux conversation record. The connect asks this type whether the pane still needs a shell frame. The footer switch gates the canvas push and the shell. The SSH checkbox only makes the shell available. The footer switch, when off, clears a checked SSH shell. The constructed mood sits between OPENER and CLOSER. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MoodDesk

    • announceBody

      public static String announceBody(boolean told, String held, String want)
      The announceBody method builds the shell frame for this connect or this later call. The normalize(String) method trims want and held. The method compares a null trimmed value as an empty string. The method returns null when told is true and those keys are equal. The method returns shell_mood_clear: and a newline when the wanted line is null. The method returns shell_mood:, a newline, the wanted line, and a newline otherwise. The pane that has not been told receives the mood, including a clear. The pane that already holds the same line receives nothing.
      Parameters:
      told - Whether this connection already announced.
      held - The line last announced, or empty.
      want - The line to announce, or empty to clear.
      Returns:
      The frame body, or null when the pane already matches.

    • parseShell

      public static String parseShell(String text)
      The parseShell method reads a mood frame from one channel body. The method returns null when text is null or empty. The first line ends at the first newline, or at the end when there is no newline. The method removes one trailing carriage return from that first line. The method returns an empty string when the first line starts with shell_mood_clear:. The method returns null when the first line does not start with shell_mood:. The method returns an empty string when shell_mood: has no newline after it. The rest is the text after the first newline. The method removes one trailing line feed from the rest. The method then removes one trailing carriage return. The method returns that rest trimmed, and the trimmed rest may be empty.
      Parameters:
      text - The stripped channel body.
      Returns:
      The mood line, an empty string when the frame clears, or null when this is not a mood frame.

    • seat

      public List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> seat(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> stored, String hostPrompt, String previousLine, String nextLine)
      The seat method rebuilds the message list for one mood change. The method returns a new list and does not change stored. The normalize(String) method trims nextLine and previousLine. The method treats a null hostPrompt as an empty string. The prompt is configured when that trimmed text has length greater than zero. The method collects mood texts from the previous line, the next line, and each system message that sits immediately before a closer. The remember(List, String, String, boolean) method skips a null line, skips a line equal to the configured prompt, and keeps the first copy of each other line. The method skips a null message. The method skips a system message whose text is the opener, the closer, or LEGACY. The method skips a system message whose next message is the closer or LEGACY. The method skips a system message whose text is one of the collected mood lines. The first remaining system message is kept as the prompt message. The other remaining messages go into the body. The result starts with a new system message of the configured prompt when no prompt message was kept and a prompt is configured. The result starts with the kept prompt message when one was found. The result has no leading prompt when none was kept and no prompt is configured. The result appends OPENER, the next line, and CLOSER as three system messages when the next line is not null. The result appends no triple when the next line is null. The body is appended after that.
      Specified by:
      seat in interface MoodDoor
      Parameters:
      stored - The current messages, or null when the list is absent.
      hostPrompt - The configured system prompt, or empty when no prompt is configured.
      previousLine - The previous mood line, or null.
      nextLine - The mood line to store, or null to clear the triple.
      Returns:
      The replacement message list.

    • adopt

      public String adopt(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> stored)
      The adopt method reads the constructed mood already stored. The method returns null when stored is null. The method finds the first system message. The seatedLine(List, int) call at that index returns the mood when the triple or the legacy pair matches. The seatedLine(List, int) call at the next index is used when the first index does not match. The method then scans each user message with lineAtTurnHead(String). The method returns null when no mood is found.
      Specified by:
      adopt in interface MoodDoor
      Parameters:
      stored - The current messages, or null when the list is absent.
      Returns:
      The trimmed mood line, or null when no mood is stored.

    • porchRules

      public String porchRules(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages)
      The porchRules method returns the mood rules text for a prompt or a stored region. The method returns an empty string when messages is null. The method finds the first system message. The method returns pairText(List, int) at that index when its length is greater than zero. The method returns pairText(List, int) at the next index when that text has length greater than zero. The rulesFromTurn(List) method supplies the text when neither pair has text. The configured system prompt stays out of the returned text. The method returns an empty string when no pair is present.
      Specified by:
      porchRules in interface MoodDoor
      Parameters:
      messages - The prompt messages or the stored region.
      Returns:
      The rules text, or an empty string.

    • spliceTurn

      public static String spliceTurn(String turn, String line)
      The spliceTurn method writes the invitation at the head of a turn, then the turn text. The head is the mood label, the line, the shape label, OPENER, and CLOSER. The line is not repeated between the two sentences. The unspliceTurn(String) method removes a stored head first, including a head in the older order. The method returns that stripped turn when normalize(String) of line is null. The method returns the invitation plus that stripped turn otherwise. // @aa-sdd GK-1000 aetheris-plan-f-198.001.md FINESSE:f-198
      Parameters:
      turn - The turn text. The method treats a null turn as an empty string after the head is removed.
      line - The mood line, or null when the splice should clear.
      Returns:
      The turn the prompt sends.

    • unspliceTurn

      public static String unspliceTurn(String turn)
      The unspliceTurn method removes one spliced mood from the head of a turn. The method returns an empty string when turn is null. The method returns the turn unchanged when lineAtTurnHead(String) finds no mood. The method removes a head written by inviteHead(String) when the turn starts with that head. The method removes an older head of OPENER, the line, and CLOSER when the turn starts with that older head. The method returns the turn unchanged when neither head matches the start.
      Parameters:
      turn - The prompt turn to strip.
      Returns:
      The turn with one spliced mood removed.

    • lineAtTurnHead

      public static String lineAtTurnHead(String turn)
      The lineAtTurnHead method returns the mood at the head of a turn. The method returns null when turn is null. The invitedLine(String) method is tried first. The olderSpliceLine(String) method is tried when the invitation form does not match. The method returns null when neither form matches.
      Parameters:
      turn - The prompt turn to read.
      Returns:
      The mood at the head of the turn, or null when no head matches.

    • invitedLine

      private static String invitedLine(String turn)
      The invitedLine method returns the mood when the head is the invitation. The method returns null when the turn does not start with mood: . The method returns null when that label has no newline after it. The method returns null when the text between the label and the newline trims to empty. The text after that newline must start with shape:, a newline, OPENER, a newline, and CLOSER. The text may end there or continue after one more newline. The method returns null when the text does not match. The method returns the normalized mood line when the text matches.
      Parameters:
      turn - The prompt turn to read.
      Returns:
      The mood when the head is the invitation, or null when it is not.

    • olderSpliceLine

      private static String olderSpliceLine(String turn)
      The olderSpliceLine method returns the mood when the head is still the opener, the line, and the closer. The method returns null when the turn does not start with OPENER and a newline. The method returns null when no newline follows that prefix. The method returns null when the text between those newlines trims to empty. The text after the line must start with CLOSER and a newline, or equal CLOSER. The method returns null when that text does not match. The method returns the normalized mood line when the text matches.
      Parameters:
      turn - The prompt turn to read.
      Returns:
      The mood when the head is the older splice, or null when it is not.

    • rulesFromTurn

      private static String rulesFromTurn(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages)
      The rulesFromTurn method reads mood rules from the first spliced user turn. The method uses the first user message whose lineAtTurnHead(String) is not null. The returned text is inviteHead(String) of that line without its last character. The method returns an empty string when no user turn has a spliced head.
      Parameters:
      messages - The prompt messages to scan.
      Returns:
      The rules text from a spliced turn, or an empty string.

    • tripleText

      private static String tripleText(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages, int at)
      The tripleText method joins one opener, mood, and closer into rules text. The method returns an empty string when index at is not OPENER. The method returns an empty string when the message two rows later is not CLOSER. The method returns an empty string when the middle text trims to empty or is a wrapper sentence. The method returns OPENER, a blank line, the mood, a blank line, and CLOSER otherwise.
      Parameters:
      messages - The prompt messages to read.
      at - The index of the opener.
      Returns:
      The rules text, or an empty string.

      private static boolean systemText(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages, int index, String text)
      The systemText method reports whether one system row holds an exact text. The method returns false when messages is null. The method returns false when index is outside the list. The method returns false when the row is not a system message. The method returns true when text equals that row. The method returns false when the texts differ.
